results.note: Praefatio by Walafridus Strabo. No English translation found despite searches.
Glossae Latino-barbaricae Rabani. Medieval Latin glossary commentary. No English translation located.
Carmen de S. Michaele (Poem on Saint Michael). Walafrid's poetic works remain largely untranslated. No English translation found.
De Maria virgine (On the Virgin Mary). Very brief work (35 words). No English translation found.
De rebus ecclesiasticis (On Ecclesiastical Matters). Large work (17,499 words) on Church organization and sacraments. No English translation located despite searches.
De singulis festivitatibus anni (On Individual Festival Days of the Year). Liturgical commentary. No English translation found.
De subversione Jerusalem (On the Destruction of Jerusalem). Historical/prophetic work. No English translation located despite searches.

De visionibus Wettini (Visio Wettini/Vision of Wetti). English translation by David A. Traill: Walahfrid Strabo's Visio Wettini: Text, Translation and Commentary (Brill, 1974). Published academic edition.
Epitaphium Geroldi comitis (Epitaph of Count Gerold). Very brief poetic epitaph (36 words). No English translation found.
Epitome Commentariorum Rabani in Leviticum. Epitome of biblical commentary. No English translation located despite searches.
Homilia in initium Evangelii S. Matthaei (Homily on the Beginning of Matthew's Gospel). No English translation found despite searches.

Hortulus (My Little Garden). English translations by Raef Payne with commentary by Wilfrid Blunt (Hunt Botanical Library, 1966) and James Mitchell (Ithuriel's Spear, 2009). Raef Payne edition freely available on Internet Archive (archive.org/details/hortulus0000wala) and Hunt Botanical Library website.
Hymnus Agaunensibus martyribus (Hymn to the Martyrs of Agaune). Hymnic poetry. No English translation located despite searches.
Hymnus de natali Domini (Hymn on the Nativity of the Lord). Liturgical hymn. No English translation found.
Picturae historiarum Novi Testamenti (Pictures/Descriptions of New Testament Histories). Description of biblical narrative scenes. No English translation located.
Versus de rebus diversis (Verses on Diverse Matters). Collection of poetic verses. No English translation found despite searches.
Versus in Aquisgrani palatio editi (Verses Composed at the Palace of Aachen). Court poetry. No English translation located despite searches.
Vita S. Blaitmaici (Life of Saint Blathmac). Metrical hagiography of the Irish martyr Blathmac (d. 825). No English translation found despite searches.
Vita S. Galli (Life of Saint Gall). Large hagiographic work (19,375 words) on the Irish-Swiss hermit saint. No complete English translation located despite searches.
Vita S. Mammae (Life of Saint Mamma). Metrical hagiography of the Cappadocian martyr. No English translation found despite searches.

Vita S. Othmari (Life of Saint Othmar). English translation by Albrecht Diem in The Many Worlds of Otmar: St. Gall and European Monasticism from the 7th to the 9th Century (Vandenhoeck & Ruprecht, June 2025). Published academic edition.
Canon episcopalis sive De institutione episcopi (Canon on the Institution of a Bishop). Instructions for bishops written c. 1197. No English translation located despite searches.
Compendium in Job (Compendium on the Book of Job). Medieval biblical commentary. No complete English translation found despite searches.

Contra perfidiam Judaeorum (Against the Perfidy of the Jews). Partial English excerpts exist online (Fordham Medieval Sourcebook with table of contents and Chapter I only; fragments in Henry T. Riley's Ingulf's Chronicle translation, 1854), but no complete modern English translation located.
De Hierosolymitana peregrinatione (On the Jerusalem Pilgrimage). Letter written 1189 regarding crusade. No English translation found despite searches.

De XII utilitatibus tribulationis (On the Twelve Benefits of Tribulation). Note: work is likely pseudo-Peter of Blois (attribution uncertain). Prose English text of 'Twelve Profits of Tribulation' exists in Horstmann's edition of Richard Rolle's works, but relationship between this Latin treatise and English text unclear.
De amicitia Christiana et de charitate Dei et proximi (On Christian Friendship and Love of God and Neighbor). Large theological treatise (32,816 words). No English translation found despite searches.
De confessione sacramentali (On Sacramental Confession). Theological treatise on confession. No English translation located despite searches.
De conversione S. Pauli (On the Conversion of Saint Paul). Brief work on apostle's conversion. No English translation found.
De divisione et scriptoribus sacrorum librorum (On the Division and Writers of Sacred Books). Biblical introductory work. No English translation located despite searches.
De poenitentia a sacerdote injugenda (On Penance to be Imposed by the Priest). Sacramental theology. No English translation found.
De transfiguratione Domini (On the Transfiguration of the Lord). Christological treatise. No English translation located despite searches.
Dialogus inter regem Henricum II et abbatem Bonaevallensem (Dialogue between King Henry II and the Abbot of Bonevaux). Political dialogue on kingship. No English translation found despite searches.

Epistolae (Letters). Very large collection (165,578 words). Partial English translations exist: selections by G.A. Loud on Sicilian letters; fragments by Henry T. Riley in Ingulf's Chronicle continuation (1854); selections on Fordham Medieval Sourcebook. No complete English translation of full letter collection located.
Fragmenta epistolae de silentio servando (Fragments of a Letter on Maintaining Silence). Brief epistolary fragment. No English translation found.
Invectiva in depravatorem operum Petri Blesensis (Invective Against the Corruptr of Peter of Blois's Works). Defense of authorship. No English translation located despite searches.
Libellus de arte dictandi (Treatise on the Art of Letter-Writing). Ars dictaminis manual. No English translation found.
Passio Reginaldi principis (Passion of Prince Reynald). Hagiographic account of Reynald of Châtillon as crusader martyr. No English translation located despite searches.
Poemata (Poems/Poetry Collection). Latin verse collection. No English translation found despite searches.
Sermones (Sermons). Large collection (82,193 words) of Latin sermons. No complete English translation located despite searches.
Tractatus quales sunt (Treatise of What Kind They Are). Theological treatise. No English translation found despite searches.
